Two students dead in Philippines school shooting

A 7th-grade student opened fire at a school in Zamboanga City, Philippines, killing a classmate and then himself. Mayor Khymer Adan Olaso stated that the gunman first fired at a teacher, though it is unclear if the teacher was hit. The incident marks the second school shooting in the Philippines within two months.
